segments.ipa: /ɪf ju du wɑnt tu ʃoʊ ə ˈlɪtəl ˈɛkstrə səˈpɔrt ðɛrz ðæt dʒɔɪn ˈbʌtən bɪˈloʊ ənd ju kæn bɪˈkʌm ə ˈmɛmbər ɑn maɪ ˈtʃænəl ənd jul ɡɛt sʌm/

segments.text: perks including early access to my videos as well as priority reply to your comments,
segments.ipa: /pɝks ˌɪnˈkludɪŋ ˈɝli ˈækˌsɛs tu maɪ ˈvɪdioʊz æz wɛl æz praɪˈɔrəti rɪˈplaɪ tu jɔr ˈkɑmɛnts/

segments.text: Thanks so much for watching and I'll see you in the next one. Bye.
segments.ipa: /θæŋks soʊ mʌtʃ fɔr ˈwɑtʃɪŋ ənd aɪl si ju ɪn ðə nɛkst wʌn baɪ/
